items.title: David Weinstein Interview, 1988-09-22
items.q: when, when we played the jazz tunes, Sharky would, uh, would run the brass section, you see.

ctx.x: read music a lot better than Sharky. Could Sharky play second parts by ear?

Oh no, he, Sharky could read, but he, he was, he was a rehearsal reader, if you know what I mean. He'd have to rehearse a tune a few times to get it. But then, when, when we played the jazz tunes, Sharky would, uh, would run the brass section, you see.
They have many side readers in the band?
